audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Renekton level 1 while the page's own text opens with 'Rumble owns level 1', gave Renekton level 2 as 'Skill' while whys[1] says the burn wins the trade even after your stun, and gave first item outright to Rumble while whys[5] describes it as conditional on whether you killed him pre-6.
audit.why: Renekton is at 47.74% and the reason is that Flamespitter has no window Renekton can exploit early — the page says so and the packet chart agrees on all three rows.
audit.corrected: Rumble, Rumble, Rumble, Rumble, Renekton, Skill, Rumble in both layers as one atomic group, with level 1 dropping to 3/10 and first item moving to 5/10.
sources: existing early text, whys[0], whys[1], whys[5]

audit.why: Spikes are correct and well-placed: his level 1-2, your Dominus window at 6, his Liandry's, and Equalizer as a teamfight wall. The Equalizer is 130s at rank 1, which is why it reads as a fight-defining placement rather than a repeatable trade tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built around 'track Scrap Shield' and 'bait it, then commit' — but Scrap Shield is a flat 6-second cooldown, so baiting it buys almost nothing. The real no-answer window was never mentioned: at 100% Heat Rumble Overheats and cannot cast spells at all. Empowered Ruthless Predator also destroys Scrap Shield outright above 50 Fury, which the page never says.
audit.why: Rumble W: 'Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed', cd 6 flat. Rumble P: 'When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating... making him unable to cast spells'. Renekton W: 'destroying damage shields on the target'. Advice keyed to a 6s cooldown is advice keyed to nothing; advice keyed to his Heat bar is actionable every single trade.
audit.corrected: The do's, the interactions line and whys[3] now point the player at the Heat bar and at Overheat as the commit window, state Scrap Shield's real 6s cooldown, and state that an empowered W destroys the shield.
sources: kit: Rumble W text and cd 6

audit.whatIsWrong: A Key Trigger reads simply 'Build MR', with no acknowledgement that Electro Harpoon reduces Magic Resist and can be held two charges at a time on a 0.5s cooldown.
audit.why: Stacking MR into a champion whose E shreds MR is a partial answer at best; the player should know the shred exists before he buys around it. Reported rather than rewritten because the title string is 8 characters and the applier skips short strings.
audit.corrected: Reported here for a hand fix; the body of that trigger is generic trade boilerplate and would also benefit from the harpoon detail.
sources: kit: Rumble E text and cd 0.5, 2 charges

edits.before: He still wins sustained trades via Flamespitter heat stacks; your pattern works only when his Q has just been fired or he is at low heat with no instant access to the channel.
edits.after: He wins sustained trades on Flamespitter, so commit when he is Overheated at 100% Heat and locked out of casting — that is the only guaranteed no-answer window.

edits.before: Use Scrap Shield's move speed right after your combo to disengage and let the DoT finish the trade in his favour
edits.after: Re-press Scrap Shield every 6s to disengage after your combo and let the burn finish the trade for him

edits.before: Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Scrap Shield is only 6s — engage on Overheat, not the shield.

edits.before: Rumble wastes Scrap Shield — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: At 50+ Fury your W destroys Scrap Shield and stuns him 1.5s.

edits.before: Track Rumble's Scrap Shield: Bait it, then commit. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Scrap Shield is 6s flat; at 100% Heat he Overheats and cannot cast — that is your window.

notes: The packet suspectName "Scrap Shield's" in whys[2] is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Rumble's real W name with a possessive. Three chart rows proposed as matched full/content pairs in one group, matching the packet and the page's own prose. Heeded the Rumble-side mirror's warning: the kit file mis-derives 'knockup' and 'terrain' flags onto Scrap Shield when Riot's description is only a shield plus a speed burst, so nothing displacement-related was written for it. The packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' is now addressed by pointing the player at the Heat bar and Overheat rather than at a 6-second shield. Left for a hand fix: the Key Trigger titled 'Build MR' (8 characters, below the applier's skip threshold) ignores that Electro Harpoon shreds Magic Resist on a 0.5s cooldown with two charges held.
